func listDirectory(path string, showIcons, showDirsOnly, hideHidden bool) []FileEntry {
	files := []FileEntry{}

	entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		return files
	}

	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		isHidden := strings.HasPrefix(name, ".")

		if hideHidden && isHidden {
			continue
		}

		if showDirsOnly && !entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}

		var icon string
		if showIcons {
			if entry.IsDir() {
				icon = "di"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
				icon = "ln"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeNamedPipe != 0 {
				icon = "pi"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSocket != 0 {
				icon = "so"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeDevice != 0 {
				if entry.Type()&os.ModeCharDevice != 0 {
					icon = "cd"
				} else {
					icon = "bd"
				}
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSetuid != 0 {
				icon = "su"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSetgid != 0 {
				icon = "sg"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSticky != 0 {
				icon = "st"
			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSetuid != 0 || entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSetgid != 0 || entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSticky != 0 {
				icon = "ex"
			} else {
				icon = "fi"
			}
		}

		files = append(files, FileEntry{
			Name:     name,
			IsDir:    entry.IsDir(),
			IsHidden: isHidden,
			Icon:     icon,
		})
	}

	return files
}

+//go:build ignore
+
+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const Version = "v1.13.0"
+
+type FileEntry struct {
+	Name     string
+	IsDir    bool
+	IsHidden bool
+	Icon     string
+}
+
+func main() {
+	// Parse flags
+	showIcons := false
+	showDirsOnly := false
+	hideHidden := false
+
+	args := os.Args[1:]
+	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
+		switch args[i] {
+		case "--icons":
+			showIcons = true
+		case "--dir-only":
+			showDirsOnly = true
+		case "--hide-hidden":
+			hideHidden = true
+		case "--help", "-h":
+			printHelp()
+			os.Exit(0)
+		case "--version", "-v":
+			fmt.Println(Version)
+			os.Exit(0)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Get path from args (first non-flag argument)
+	path := "."
+	for _, arg := range args {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--") {
+			path = arg
+			break
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Check if path exists
+	if _, err := os.Stat(path); os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: path '%s' does not exist\n", path)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+
+	// Check if it's a directory
+	info, err := os.Stat(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: cannot access '%s': %v\n", path, err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+
+	if !info.IsDir() {
+		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: '%s' is not a directory\n", path)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+
+	// List directory
+	files := listDirectory(path, showIcons, showDirsOnly, hideHidden)
+
+	if len(files) == 0 {
+		fmt.Println("Directory is empty")
+		os.Exit(0)
+	}
+
+	// Print files
+	for _, f := range files {
+		fmt.Println(f.Name)
+	}
+}
+
+func printHelp() {
+	fmt.Println()
+	fmt.Printf("  walk %s\n\n", Version)
+	fmt.Println("  Usage: walk [path]\n")
+	fmt.Println("    arrows, hjkl  Move cursor")
+	fmt.Println("    enter         Enter directory")
+	fmt.Println("    backspace     Exit directory")
+	fmt.Println("    space         Toggle preview")
+	fmt.Println("    esc, q        Exit with cd")
+	fmt.Println("    ctrl+c        Exit without cd")
+	fmt.Println("    /             Fuzzy search")
+	fmt.Println("    d, delete     Delete file or dir")
+	fmt.Println("    y             Copy to clipboard")
+	fmt.Println("    .             Hide hidden files")
+	fmt.Println("    ?             Show help")
+	fmt.Println()
+	fmt.Println("  Flags:")
+	fmt.Println()
+	fmt.Println("    --icons        display icons")
+	fmt.Println("    --dir-only     show dirs only")
+	fmt.Println("    --hide-hidden  hide hidden files")
+	fmt.Println("    --preview      display preview")
+	fmt.Println("    --with-border  preview with border")
+	fmt.Println("    --fuzzy        fuzzy mode")
+	fmt.Println()
+}
+
+func listDirectory(path string, showIcons, showDirsOnly, hideHidden bool) []FileEntry {
+	files := []FileEntry{}
+
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return files
+	}
+
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		name := entry.Name()
+		isHidden := strings.HasPrefix(name, ".")
+
+		if hideHidden && isHidden {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		if showDirsOnly && !entry.IsDir() {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		var icon string
+		if showIcons {
+			if entry.IsDir() {
+				icon = "di"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+				icon = "ln"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeNamedPipe != 0 {
+				icon = "pi"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSocket != 0 {
+				icon = "so"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeDevice != 0 {
+				if entry.Type()&os.ModeCharDevice != 0 {
+					icon = "cd"
+				} else {
+					icon = "bd"
+				}
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSetuid != 0 {
+				icon = "su"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSetgid != 0 {
+				icon = "sg"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModeSticky != 0 {
+				icon = "st"
+			} else if entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSetuid != 0 || entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSetgid != 0 || entry.Type()&os.ModePerm&os.ModeSticky != 0 {
+				icon = "ex"
+			} else {
+				icon = "fi"
+			}
+		}
+
+		files = append(files, FileEntry{
+			Name:     name,
+			IsDir:    entry.IsDir(),
+			IsHidden: isHidden,
+			Icon:     icon,
+		})
+	}
+
+	return files
+}
